AboutPage.title: About Research Hub
AboutPage.description: Learn more about our mission and features.
AboutPage.missionText: Research Hub aims to provide a centralized and accessible platform for researchers to share, discover, and collaborate on academic papers across various disciplines. We strive to foster a community of knowledge sharing and innovation.
AboutPage.featureUpload: Seamlessly upload research papers with relevant metadata (title, authors, abstract).
AboutPage.featureSearch: Utilize advanced search capabilities to find papers by keywords, authors, or publication year.
AboutPage.featureAdmin: Admin tools for categorizing papers by discipline and managing user access levels (public/private).
